This is the public fixed module-signing fixture embedded in pkg/build/linux.go at upstream commit d30566576f7a27c00eed678f3c2750c9b3c87473. Its bytes are unchanged. It is used for reproducible fuzz-kernel builds and carries no private identity or service access. The Apache-2.0 upstream LICENSE applies. It was moved to testdata and embedded so snapshot checks can distinguish the public fixture from credential carriers. No kernel build is needed for the hints task.
